text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: ご期待に沿えず申し訳ございません……
choice_data_list_en: I'm so sorry for failing to meet your expectations...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Pay it no mind.
I should be the one apologizing for making unreasonable demands.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so even you have things you aren't good at, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Shall we ask Ruler for some pointers next time?
The two of us, together.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Who knows, perhaps I might have
a greater aptitude for it than you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
